Fund-type tables (directors report section 'נתונים כמותיים אודות קופות הגמל שבניהול החברה'): the five fund-type columns are segment provident with fund_type = provident_savings_compensation (קופות גמל אישיות לתגמולים ופיצויים), study_fund (קרנות השתלמות), other_provident_funds (קופה מרכזית לפיצויים), investment_provident (קופת גמל להשקעה), child_savings (קופת גמל להשקעה לחיסכון ארוך טווח לילד); the 'סך הכל' column has no fund_type. sub = active / inactive / total (members, accounts, AUM) or active_and_inactive (management fees). Column identity was checked per table against the printed header; the five fund-type values add to the 'סך הכל' value (tolerance 2) in every table except the one exception noted in the period notes, active + inactive = total, and each value was matched to a number on its page.

Windows: the flow and fee tables are cumulative from 1 January: q in Q1 reports, ytd (six / nine months) in Q2 / Q3 reports, fy in annual reports and for the prior year-end comparative; each comparative column is recorded with its own date. Stand-alone Q2 / Q3 flows are not printed (the Q2 2026 stand-alone figures in the deck are differences of printed cumulative columns and are not recorded). Income-statement items have q, ytd and fy columns as printed. Balances are instant.

Fee rates (fee_rate_from_assets active / inactive, fee_rate_from_deposits) are printed per fund type only, in annualised terms, with no total column; no aggregate was computed. management_fees_from_assets / _from_deposits are the 'דמי ניהול שנגבו' rows (thousand NIS) of the same table; the income statement line 'הכנסות מדמי ניהול מקופות גמל, נטו' (metric management_fees) is a different, net figure.

Income statement: selling_and_marketing_expenses = 'עמלות שיווק והפצה' (agent recurring and target commissions, bank distribution commissions, net of capitalised target commissions, i.e. includes amortisation of deferred acquisition costs). other_expenses = 'הוצאות בגין קבלת שירותים ושאילת עובדים מהחברה האם' (separate line; the deck counts it with general and administrative expenses). general_and_administrative_expenses = 'הוצאות הנהלה וכלליות'. The directors report table 4.1 ('ניתוח תוצאות הפעילות') adds five quarterly columns: its total_revenue_excl_finance_income, total_operating_expenses, operating_profit (revenues = fees + securities gains, before net finance), net_finance_income_expense and income_tax_board_table (negative as printed) are board-table definitions and differ from the income-statement lines of the same name root; where both documents print the same line and date the values were checked to be equal.
